records.translation: 正常运行时返回 ``None``，此时已将掩膜、叠加图、``measurements.db`` 计数和设置 CSV 写入 ``src`` 的子文件夹。设置 ``dry_run`` 时，改为返回 :func:`spacr.validate.run_preflight` 的问题列表。设置 ``watch_folder`` 时，返回一个字典，列出监视结束时已分析、失败及始终未完成的图像视野。经校准的 V2 分割则写出独立数据集，包含非定量的对齐显示平面和参考画布掩膜；原始数据通道保持不变，Measure 拒绝这些经校准的输出。可选的 ``unmix_matrix_file`` 为经校准的单板二维细胞 V2 路径提供明确的归一化相机信号矩阵，代替对照估计。采集兼容性是用户未经验证的声明；会记录确切矩阵及其校准绑定。

This requires calibrated organized 2D cell V2 processing, no control microplate sample positions, and ``unmix_per_plate=False``. Its physical channels must match the packed order exactly; no transpose, channel reordering or diagonal renormalization is inferred. ``matrix[i][j]`` is the camera reading in row-channel ``i`` per unit of the dye measured in its own column-channel ``j``. records.context: Replace the example calibration hash with 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. Background percentile must equal ``unmix_background_percentile``. Laboratory microplate, time and Z must equal every mapped microscope field of view's exact acquisition IDs, including their string or integer types; an absent time or Z uses the empty string. This supplied-file route requires POSIX descriptor-relative access without symbolic links; unsupported platforms refuse before creating outputs. The acquisition-compatibility token is an unverified user assertion: unknown gains, exposures and response remain unknown. The file is captured before outputs and copied byte-for-byte into ``psf/spectral_matrix_input.json``. Signed-cell readers validate that copied bundle and never depend on the original external path. An empty path preserves control-estimation behavior.

records.translation: 将示例校准哈希替换为 64 个小写十六进制数字。背景百分位数必须等于 ``unmix_background_percentile``。板、时间和 Z 必须与每个映射图像视野的确切采集 ID 一致，包括其字符串或整数类型；缺少时间或 Z 时使用空字符串。此提供文件路径要求不经过符号链接的 POSIX 描述符相对访问；不支持的平台在创建输出前拒绝。采集兼容性令牌是用户未经验证的声明：未知的增益、曝光和响应仍然未知。文件在输出前捕获，并逐字节复制到 ``psf/spectral_matrix_input.json``。带符号细胞数据读取器验证此复制的包，从不依赖原始外部路径。空路径保留对照估计行为。
